headline: Himachal Pradesh: HRTC bus hit by shooting stones at Kinnaur landslide point
content: SHIMLA: Another Himachal Road Transport Corporation (HRTC) bus was hit by shooting stones at Nigulsari, where a massive landslide had occurred on Wednesday. Two people, including a lady, who were travelling in the HRTC bus were injured and were taken to Community Health Centre Bhawanagar for treatment. Meanwhile, the death toll in Wednesday’s landslide incident has increased to 17 with the recovery of three more bodies.Kinnaur landslide: Photos of search and rescue operationsOfficials said that NH-5 is through for the vehicular activities and a police team has been deployed for the management of traffic.85297355 They said that the Bolero and its passengers who were hit by a massive landslide on Wednesday are not still untraceable. It might be possible that the vehicle had rolled down with the debris.85238585According to SHO Bhawanagar, the HRTC bus on its way to Reckongpeo from Sundernagar in Mandi district was hit by shooting stones at Nigulsari sliding point around 4.40pm resulting in injuries to two passengers and both were shifted to hospital for treatment. Those injured have been identified as Anita Kumari (40) of Jani village of Kinnaur district and Anubhav Negi (19) of Kalpa village.In the wake of threat to commuters due to the possible landslide and shooting stones at sliding point Nigulari, the sub-divisional magistrate on Thursday had ordered that no vehicles would ply from this point from 9pm to 9am till further orders. SDM Manmohan Singh has directed the SHO of Bhawanagar police station to deploy police personnel on both sides of the sliding point to ensure that vehicles do not cross between 9pm to 9am.
